11: | `label` | Etykieta (ang. *label*) pochodząca z korpusu: `spam` lub `ham`, czyli prawidłowa poczta. Służy do uczenia i oceny, ale nie jest wejściem modelu podczas przewidywania. |

from collections import Counter

def load_csv(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:

val_rows = load_csv("data/validation.csv")

    r"(irish linux users|ilug@linux\.ie|social@linux\.ie|listmaster@linux\.ie|"
    r"rpm-list mailing list|rpm-list@freshrpms\.net|lists\.freshrpms\.net|"
    r"lists\.sourceforge\.net/lists/listinfo|spamassassin-talk@|spamassassin-devel@|"
    r"razor-users@|exmh-users@|exmh-workers@|listman\.redhat\.com|"
    r"forteana-unsubscribe@egroups\.com|xent\.com/mailman/listinfo|"
    r"python\.org/mailman/listinfo|spambayes@python\.org)",
    re.I
)

def clean_area1(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if lines and lines[0].lower().startswith("subject:"):
        subj = lines[0][8:].strip()
        subj = re.sub(r"\[[^\]]+\]", " ", subj)
        lines[0] = subj
    kept = [ln for ln in lines if not footer_line_re.search(ln)]
    out = "\n".join(kept)
    out = re.sub(r"[\w\.-]*zzzz[\w\.-]*(@[\w\.-]+)?", " ", out, flags=re.I)
    out = re.sub(r"[\w\.-]*@?spamassassin\.taint\.org", " ", out, flags=re.I)
    return out

def tokenize_raw(text):
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())

def tokenize_masked(text):
    t = text.lower()
    t = re.sub(r"(?:https?://|www\.)\S+", " __url__ ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}", " __email__ ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"(\$|€|£|usd|eur)\s*\d+([.,]\d+)?|\d+([.,]\d+)?\s*(euros?|dollars?|pounds?)", " __money__ ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"\b\d+([.,:-]\d+)*\b", " __num__ ", t)
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_]+", t)

for mode_name, tok_fn in [("Prosty podział na słowa [a-z0-9]+ (bez maskowania URL/EMAIL/NUM)", tokenize_raw),
                          ("Po zamaskowaniu <URL>, <EMAIL>, <MONEY>, <NUM>", tokenize_masked)]:

    train_docs = [tok_fn(clean_area1(r["text"])) for r in train_rows]
    val_docs = [tok_fn(clean_area1(r["text"])) for r in val_rows]

    doc_freq = Counter()
    total_freq = Counter()
    for doc in train_docs:
        total_freq.update(doc)
        doc_freq.update(set(doc))

    vocab_all = set(doc_freq.keys())
    vocab_min2 = {w for w, df in doc_freq.items() if df >= 2}
    vocab_min3 = {w for w, df in doc_freq.items() if df >= 3}

    val_tokens_all = [w for doc in val_docs for w in doc]
    val_types_all = set(val_tokens_all)

    oov_tokens_all = sum(1 for w in val_tokens_all if w not in vocab_all)

    print(f"Rozmiar słownika train (df>=2): {len(vocab_min2)} (redukcja o {(1-len(vocab_min2)/len(vocab_all))*100:.1f}%)")
    print(f"Rozmiar słownika train (df>=3): {len(vocab_min3)}")

def load_csv(path):

def norm_subject(text):
    raw_subj = text.splitlines()[0]
    s = re.sub(r"^subject:\s*", "", raw_subj, flags=re.I)
    # Remove bracketed tags like [ILUG], [SAtalk], [was: ...]
    s = re.sub(r"\[[^\]]*\]", " ", s)
    # Repeatedly strip Re:, Fwd:, Fw: and leading punctuation/spaces
    changed = True
    while changed:
        new_s = re.sub(r"^\s*(re|fwd|fw)\s*(\[\d+\])?\s*:\s*", "", s, flags=re.I)
        new_s = re.sub(r"\[[^\]]*\]", " ", new_s).strip()
        changed = (new_s != s)
        s = new_s
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()
    return raw_subj, s

train_by_subj = defaultdict(list)
